notes: The referenced lab's synthetic PostgreSQL result does not attest any vendor source-native capture. No mainframe credentials, customer topology or native manuals have been supplied.

sources.description: IDCAMS LOGREPLICATE/LOGSTREAMID setup for specified Classic CDC VSAM path
CICS TS, CICS VR batch non-RLS, TVS/batch RLS have different writer-path capture
Version/product prerequisites vary; CICS VR required for non-CICS batch in documented path
DL/I batch prerequisites DBRC=Y, DFSFLGX0, permanent IEFRDER in documented product
Some DL/I batch logs unavailable until step ends, delays log merge/order
Remote journal state, latency, filters and sender/receiver metrics are exposed
Remote journal start receiver, sync/async delivery, filtering and restart are configurable
Receiver chain deletion can remove required recovery data; archive/retention is an explicit operational risk

families.mechanism: Recovery-log replication (product/version dependent; Q Capture is a candidate, not universally installed)
families.risk: Db2 transaction log mechanisms cannot be assumed configured or available for every table; verify actual product manuals and subsystem

discovery: VSAM dataset cluster and access modes
families.risk: Dataset load-mode records and bypass paths may not appear in replication log

families.mechanism: CICS VR non-RLS batch path, DFSMStvs for RLS/TVS where supported, or other approved approach
discovery: all batch JCL and utility jobs
CICS VR product and FRLOG setup
families.risk: CICS logger alone does not cover all direct VSAM batch writes

families.mechanism: Product-specific IMS log capture and ordering (conditional)
families.risk: IMS source log reader ordering and product support must be validated for actual database types

families.mechanism: IMS Classic CDC batch log capture subject to configured prerequisites and step-close lag
discovery: step duration, log close and ordering suspension
families.risk: Unclosed DL/I batch steps can defer ordering/visibility for hours; violates assumed low-lag envelope

families.platform: IBM i / Db2 for i and journaled files
families.mechanism: Local/remote journal receiver chain, conditional on journaling configuration
discovery: remote journal state and delivery mode
families.risk: Filtered and expired receiver chains can omit data necessary for a complete and restartable projection
